διίημι: drive, thrust through (a weapon); disband (an army)
κατεφάλλομαι: to spring down upon, rush upon
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
παρίημι: to pass over, let go, relax, yield, allow
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute
τλάω: to take upon oneself, to bear, suffer, undergo
ἀνίημι: to send up; let go, abate
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἐκλύω: to loose, release, set free, from
ἐξίστημι: to put out of its place, to change
ἐπισεύω: to put in motion against, set upon
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἐφίημι: to send to; (mid) to long for
ἵημι: to set a going, put in motion
ὑπεξερύω: to draw out from under, draw away underhand
ὑφίστημι: to place under; mid. to submit, to promise
